correctness.rationale: Every down-beat witness in X is unchanged by adjoining two universal maxima, and every up-beat witness y remains least because y lies below both new maxima. Hence any beat-deletion sequence X down to C lifts verbatim. If C is minimal with at least two points, old nonmaximal points cannot acquire an internal least upper witness and old maximal points see the incomparable pair {+,-}; a new maximum would be down beat exactly if C had a greatest element, impossible in a nontrivial minimal finite poset because a maximal point below that greatest element would then be up beat. Thus suspension(C) is minimal. If C is one point, its suspension is the three-point V-poset and collapses to a point. Iteration gives the formula. The exhaustive verifier through five labeled points is consistent but not needed for the unrestricted proof.

final_claim: For every nonempty finite T0-space X, its non-Hausdorff suspension is minimal exactly when X is minimal with at least two points; if C is a Stong core, suspension of C is the suspension core when |C|>=2, while a one-point core makes the suspension contractible, so the k-fold suspended core has size 1 in the contractible case and |C|+2k otherwise.
